audit.whatIsWrong: Rated EVEN at 5.5/10 against a 60.81% win rate over 74 games, while the mid block opens 'This is your lane.'
audit.why: The prose already treats it as a favoured matchup; only the rating disagrees.
audit.corrected: FAV at 4/10, carry threat left at 6/10 — he genuinely does take over if it goes long.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows are wrong in both layers — levels 1 through 6 and 2+ items are all marked 'Skill'. The packet chart and every why read Lucian / Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves.
audit.why: whys[0] gives level 1 to Lucian outright, whys[2] through whys[6] all describe Graves winning. A chart of six shrugs under text that says you take over at level 3 tells the player nothing.
audit.corrected: Both charts flipped as one atomic group, with Collateral Damage's 100s and the real shape of Relentless Pursuit's cooldown written into the phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is called a blind that 'cancels his Lightslinger double-shot and autos' in four places. It reduces sight range and slows on impact — it cannot cancel or miss an attack. Separately, Lucian's move speed is credited to 'his passive Vigilance': his passive is Lightslinger, and the move speed comes from attacking targets marked by Ardent Blaze (W).
audit.why: The blind line is the stated reason you win the level 2-3 flip, and it is not a real mechanic. The true reason you win it is Smoke Screen's impact slow keeping him inside point-blank range — same instruction, real justification. And a player watching for 'passive move speed' will not watch for the W mark that actually causes it.
audit.corrected: Blind replaced with the impact slow and sight cut throughout; the move speed re-attributed to Ardent Blaze marks.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Relentless Pursuit as a fixed cooldown you wait out. It is 16 seconds at rank 1 — but Riot's text states that Lightslinger attacks reduce it, and its mana cost falls to 0 at rank 5.
audit.why: It means the dash comes back faster the more he is allowed to attack, so the punish window is the one right after he has been denied attacks — not simply sixteen seconds after he used it. Counting to sixteen and stepping up is how you die here.
audit.corrected: Written into the early block as the sequencing rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lucian's passive also empowers his next two attacks whenever a nearby enemy champion is immobilized — never mentioned.
audit.why: Graves has no immobilise in his kit, so in a straight 1v1 that half of the passive never fires. The instant a jungler with any CC arrives it does. It is a concrete reason his damage jumps in a gank and not in a duel.

edits.before: Level 1 is his — his Piercing Light poke and Lightslinger double-shot chunk you while you have one ability and no Quickdraw to close, so just last-hit and accept the chip. The lane flips hard at 2-3: once End of the Line, Quickdraw and Smoke Screen are all up, you Quickdraw in onto him, drop Smoke Screen on top so the blind cancels his autos and the empowered double-shot, and unload the 4-shell spread at point-blank where it actually hurts. His only escape is one Relentless Pursuit dash, so bait it before you commit.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Piercing Light poke and the Lightslinger double-shot chunk you while you have one ability and no Quickdraw to close, so last-hit and accept the chip. The lane flips hard at 2-3: once End of the Line, Quickdraw and Smoke Screen are up, dash in, drop Smoke Screen on him so the impact slow holds him there, and unload the 4-shell spread point-blank where it actually hurts. His only escape is one Relentless Pursuit — and Lightslinger attacks shorten its cooldown, so deny him attacks and it stays down longer than the sixteen seconds on paper.

edits.before: This is your lane. Through 4-5 your True Grit armor and two stacked Quickdraw charges let you win any extended trade he tries to dash out of, and the moment he's caught mid-Piercing-Light animation you Quickdraw onto him and burst. At 6, Collateral Damage is a flat-out kill button — catch him with Relentless Pursuit down, R through him and the blast cone plus your spread deletes a squishy. Save Smoke Screen for the moment he tries to dash out, not before.
edits.after: This is your lane. Through 4-5 your True Grit stacks and two Quickdraw charges win any extended trade he tries to dash out of, and the moment he's caught mid-Piercing-Light you dash on and burst. One warning: his passive also empowers two attacks whenever a nearby enemy is immobilised — nothing in your kit immobilises, so that half only fires when their jungler arrives, and his gank damage is far above his lane damage. At 6, catch him with Relentless Pursuit down and Collateral Damage deletes a squishy.

notes: packet.suspectNames flags 'Hold Relentless Pursuit' as a probable wrong name — false positive. The 'Q's wall-bounce return' phrasing in phases[2].why has been replaced: Graves' Q detonates after 1 second or on terrain contact, it does not bounce back, and the ownerKit's derived 'creates terrain' flag on that ability contradicts Riot's own description. I also removed the 'disengage knockback' framing of Collateral Damage from phases[4] — Graves' R does not displace anyone; only his passive knocks back, and only non-champions.
